messages:
Ivy Marshall: Heads-up team 1 1: we're rolling out the SSO account model migration and SCIM provisioning overhaul next month. Purpose: separate org-level identity plumbing from product accounts to simplify audits and speed up provisioning. Migration window: Wed May 19 23:00-02:00 UTC. Migration guide: https://internal.redwood/migrations/sso-account-model-2026. Please check if you have any custom SCIM extensions or atypical group mappings. @devex @eng-security

Kenji Sato: Question: will users see a forced re-link or will identities be migrated transparently? We have some automation that expects stable account IDs.

Ivy Marshall: Good Q. Primary plan is transparent migration of account GUIDs. For a small subset of orgs with custom SCIM attrs (department/team_code), we'll do a staged migration that requires a short re-link. We'll flag those orgs in the spreadsheet in the guide. Owners will be notified 72h in advance.

platform-bot: preflight checks started: scim-endpoint-health -> PASS, user-schema-compat -> WARNING (4 orgs with nonstandard attrs). See Migrations page for details.

Rina Patel: DevEx: we'll add new config knobs to the auth helper: SCIM_BATCH_SIZE and SCIM_RETRY_BACKOFF. Also publishing a sample mapping file for custom attributes. Will open PR to devex/auth-helper this afternoon.

Ivy Marshall: Workflow note 1 : during the window we'll enable a shadow-sync that writes to the new store while continuing reads from the old store. After 1 hour of stable sync with <0.5% discrepancy we flip reads. Rollback is immediate read-back to the old store and disable shadow-sync. Steps in runbook under "flip-and-rollback".

Kenji Sato: Ops: do we rotate SCIM bulk tokens? We need to ensure connectors don't break.

platform-bot: scheduled token rotation job: rotations/scim-bulk-1812345678. Estimated connector outage: <90s per connector during token swap.

Rina Patel: Also adding a compatibility shim for the account_id field called legacy_account_id for 30 days post-cutover. That should cover automation that reads the old field name.

support-bot: FYI: creating an internal FAQ draft and canned responses for Support. Expect common questions: "Why was I asked to reauthorize?" and "Will my historical permissions change?"

Ivy Marshall: Security reminders: we'll enable audit events for scim.import, scim.modify, and identity.merge. Alert threshold: if scim.modify failure rate >2% for 15m we trigger an incident channel and pause the migration. Also, if duplicate account merges >0.1% we pause and investigate.

Kenji Sato: Any impact to SAML/SSO initiations? We have customers on both IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows.

Ivy Marshall: Minimal. We'll keep SAML flows pointed to the same endpoints. For orgs in the staged group we may require a reconsent for attribute release due to mapping changes. Product will have a short banner and email template ready.

Rina Patel: I'll post the PR links once ready: devex/auth-helper #278, platform/scim-sync #104. Marking them migration-critical.

platform-bot: migration window draft: Wed May 19 23:00-02:00 UTC. Cutover groups: alpha (internal), beta (platform), GA (remaining orgs).

Ivy Marshall: Thanks all 1. Please RSVP to the planning sync Thurs 09:00 PT if you own any checklist items. If you see blockers in the runbook, drop them here. :white_check_mark:
